label: Payment Badges
_notes: enabled_payment_types is free text listing which payment icons to show (e.g. a comma-separated list of payment method keys like visa, mastercard, paypal, apple-pay, google-pay, shop-pay). If left empty it falls back to the icons enabled in the store's own payment settings, which is a safe default — leave blank unless the product calls for spotlighting specific payment methods. All remaining real settings (icon size on desktop/mobile, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
